note: Wayne County TN has no published zoning district service found after searching ArcGIS Online/Hub and the county open data portal (data-wayne.opendata.arcgis.com lists parcels and boundaries only). The county says countywide zoning is not centralized. City of Waynesboro publishes its zoning ordinance only as a PDF (no district map service found). Clifton publishes no zoning found. Only commercial paid parcel data includes zoning.
